justification: Both are stone reliefs organized into horizontal bands with some curved motifs, but A depicts a single schematic anthropomorphic figure (face, arms, disc, belt-like curves) while B shows a multi-register frieze of naturalistically rendered animals (birds, horses, a spider-like creature) with architectural arches. There is no shared iconographic subject, pose, or relationship between elements—only the generic use of banding links them, which is too weak to suggest a common tradition.
